content: {"rule":"K-G4","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text treats Isaiah 7:14 as answered by both sides rather than as an unanswered witness counted toward a broken link.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].","rule_words":"If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.","room":"The phrase 'If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it': either the text records the verse as answered and does not count it, or its underdetermination finding implicitly counts an answered verse toward a broken link.","why":"The judge expressly says both sides answered and does not count an answered verse as an unanswered witness toward a broken link."}
